summary: Dowry death conviction under IPC s.304B, 498A, 201 challenged; insufficient evidence of cruelty 'soon before death' for dowry presumption; FIR filed 2 days post-cremation; key witness Jagir Singh not examined; High Court error in upholding conviction after acquittal of co-accused without State appeal; deceased had history of fits; conviction quashed due to lack of proximate harassment evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under s.304B, 498A, 201 IPC set aside; appellant acquitted.
